title: A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A million followers can create extraordinary reach while remaining a rented route to people—subject to platform rules, access loss, algorithmic distribution, and incomplete portability.
frames.alt: Title plate for A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: Construction evidence can outlive the operating house—but only if the physical object and record stay paired.

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · REACH — What can the platform do exceptionally well?. Discovery, social proof, conversation, cultural participation, and rapid distribution are real institutional advantages. The audit begins by naming that value rather than treating dependency as failure.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what can the platform do exceptionally well? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · ACCESS — Who can enter and recover the account?. Record the account owner, administrators, authentication method, recovery contacts, device access, and escalation route. A display name or founder face does not prove operational control.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who can enter and recover the account? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · PORTABILITY — What can leave with consent and context?. Map content originals, captions, contacts, customer records, permissions, analytics exports, and conversation history. Preserve only what may lawfully and ethically be retained.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what can leave with consent and context? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · ROUTE — How many ways can the institution reach people?. Build at least one controlled destination and one consent-based contact route. Redundancy should improve continuity without manipulating audiences or copying data beyond its stated purpose.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how many ways can the institution reach people? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Calling platforms “rented” can understate the communities, creativity, and livelihoods built there. The argument is narrower: meaningful participation and asset control are different institutional questions, and both deserve deliberate design.
